sources.review_depth: Read abstract, introduction, framework, setup and results, discussion, ethics, A.2, A.4-A.6, B.3-B.8 selected text and D.2-D.5; not every appendix, figure, artifact or target source. No benchmark executed.

sources.title: VCAO: Verifier-Centered Agentic Orchestration for Strategic OS Vulnerability Discovery
sources.review_depth: Abstract, introduction, selected algorithm text, evaluation section 6 and discussion/limitations section 7; HTML artifact-link inspection. Formal regret proof not audited; no code run.
sources.support: Proposes adaptive tool allocation and reports replay comparisons.
sources.limits: Inspected HTML has no project artifact URL. Exact task manifests and per-run evidence not established by the reviewed evaluation.
sources.experiment: Require budget-matched simple allocation baselines before considering a new optimizer.
sources.publication_status: preprint; results not independently reproduced here

repository_review.scope: Targeted continuation, not a whole-repository audit
repository_review.read: Current handoff, mission state, next-session brief, paid-findings decision, FreeTSA diagnostic contract/preparation, presentation; sampled frontier/roadmap and analyzer/receipt boundary; build and CI configuration. Earlier session architecture review remains historical.
repository_review.inference: Current receipt admission authenticates modeled output bytes; the finite experiment tests a proposed future semantic acceptance condition, not an existing receipt vulnerability.

experiment.claim_boundary: Complete only for the authored finite model. One implementation team; no operational independence, external target, production gate, real repair, discovery score or novel research claim.

limitations: Raw source captures and report logs are local ignored evidence; a fresh clone lacks them. The experiment itself is reproducible from tracked owned code.
Source retrieval timestamps are host observations, not qualified time.
